tasks.title: Add GET /api/overview/program-detail/{program_id} router
tasks.notes: app/api/overview.py, prefix /api/overview. Handler calls program_visibility(current_user, program_id) once with the REAL id (not the sentinel programs.py uses), then a single select(ProgramSummary).where(ProgramSummary.program_id == program_id); scalar_one_or_none() -> None raises HTTPException(404, 'program not found'). Maps the row to ProgramDetailResponse: header verbatim; summary is the fixed 7-entry, mockup-ordered (glyph, label) list zipped with format_number()-formatted values (card 4 = f'{repos_with_harness_installed} / {repos_total}', exempt from format_number per FR-2). Zero persona branching (FR-PD-17). Reads optional Header(alias='X-Program-Switch-From', default=None) x_program_switch_from: logs program_switch{from_program_id, to_program_id} when present/non-empty, else program_drilldown{program_id} -- exactly one, only on the 200 path, never on 404 (D-07). Module docstring notes the byte-identical invariant and the AUTH-04 href dependency, matching app/api/programs.py's documentation style (Documentation requirements).

tasks.notes: app.include_router(overview_router) alongside the existing router includes (D-07 fires this file too, same task since both edits are adjacent lines in create_app()). tasks.title: ProgramDetailView orchestrator (switch-reload, TC-03)
tasks.notes: 'use client'. Props: initialProgramId: string; initialResult: ProgramDetailResult (from the server-rendered page.tsx fetch). Owns: current programId/result state, isSwitching, switcher isOpen. On ProgramSwitcher onSelect(newId): sets isSwitching, calls fetchProgramDetail(newId, {switchedFrom: currentProgramId}) (client-side, sends X-Program-Switch-From per D-07), on resolve updates result state and calls next/navigation's useRouter().replace(`/programs/${newId}`) (client-side, no hard nav, FR-4) -- URL and rendered data update together. Fetches GET /api/programs once on mount (fetchPrograms()) for the switcher's option list, skipped entirely when initialResult.status==='not_found' (D-03). Composes BackToProgramBoard + ProgramDetailHeader (state derived from result.status) + ProgramSummaryCards or ProgramDetailErrorPanel. Test file (F-29) covers TC-03 directly against this component (not the thin Server Component page wrapper) -- equivalent behavioral coverage, avoids fighting Next.js server-component-in-vitest limitations: mocks programDetailApi's fetchProgramDetail/fetchPrograms and next/navigation's useRouter (D-09, no MSW), asserts the switch-reload fetch call, the URL update via router.replace, the back-link's target, the 404 fixture's error-state render, and the switcher trigger's aria-haspopup/aria-expanded + Enter/Space keyboard activation.
